items.title: Gross FDI climbs as net inflows turn positive
items.description: Gross foreign direct investment into India saw a significant rise in June.  Net FDI also increased substantially, recovering from a previous month's outflow.  Outward FDI, however, continued its downward trend for the past two months.  Financial, insurance, and business services were key sectors for outward investments.  Manufacturing and trade sectors also witnessed outward FDI activity.

items.title: Outward remittances under LRS up at $2.5 billion
items.description: In June, the total outward remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme soared to $2.5 billion. Notably, Indians disbursed $1.3 billion on international travel, reflecting a significant uptick from the previous month. Meanwhile, expenditure on overseas education rose to $96 million. Additionally, remittances for the upkeep of close relatives accounted for $287 million, while investments in equity and debt attracted $456 million from Indian residents.

items.title: Axis Bank set to raise $700 million through ECB swap facility
items.description: Axis Bank is set to secure seven hundred million dollars through a dedicated external commercial borrowing facility. This loan features two tranches with tenures of three and five years. The arrangement is spearheaded by CTBC Bank from Taiwan and United Overseas Bank from Singapore, with significant contributions from the World Bank's IFC. Additional banks are anticipated to participate as the syndication phase unfolds.

items.title: D-Street set for a positive start as GIFT Nifty trades firmly higher
items.description: The Nifty index recovered 0.5 percent, closing at 24,334 after touching a low. Positive global cues and FII buying supported this recovery ahead of expiry. Brent crude oil prices fell 3.2 percent, easing concerns about oil markets. The Indian rupee also strengthened by 24 paise against the US dollar. India VIX, a fear gauge, declined by 3.9 percent to 11.08 levels.

items.title: Stocks in news: Groww, Tata Motors PV, Cipla, Varun Beverages and Axis Bank
items.description: The Indian equity market experienced a positive turnaround on Tuesday, August 25, highlighted by the Nifty 50 making a robust recovery. Anticipation builds for Wednesday as Groww gears up for a significant block deal, while Cipla faces new USFDA inspectional observations. In other news, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles is set to enhance its electric vehicle offerings through a collaboration with Tata Communications for 5G technology.

items.title: Hindustan Copper OFS may not be a big draw for retail investors: Analysts
items.description: Analysts express caution regarding retail investor interest in Hindustan Copper's offer for sale.  A nearly ten percent discount may not attract investors after recent metal stock rallies.  The institutional portion saw strong demand, exceeding shares available on the first day.  Current valuations and limited upside potential raise concerns for potential subscribers.  Investors are advised to seek better entry points in the secondary market.

items.title: Small- and midcaps shine as blue-chip stocks struggle for momentum
items.description: Mid- and small-cap stocks have continued to defy index-level inertia amid a rush in primary-market listings. The average advance-to-decline (A/D) ratio - a widely watched indicator of overall market health - in August is up for the fifth consecutive month, its longest winning streak in more than two and a half years, pointing to significant investor interest beyond the typical frontbenchers that populate the two broadest gauges on the two competing exchanges.

items.title: L&T wins ₹5,000-10,000 cr 'major' order to build 3 battery storage projects in Middle East
items.description: Larsen & Toubro said its renewables business has won a major order in the Middle East to develop three battery energy storage system projects with a combined capacity of 6 GWh.

items.title: Food prices on the rise, domestic demand keeps economy strong
items.description: India's economy shows resilience with improved domestic demand and strong economic activity. Food prices have seen a broad-based increase, raising concerns for monetary policymakers. Global economic outlook remains weighed by West Asia conflicts and new US tariffs. High-frequency indicators reflect strong manufacturing and services momentum continuing into July.

items.title: India adds 1.26 million credit cards in July as spending rises; HDFC, SBI  lead the way
items.description: healthy demand Industry card additions rise 11.5% over June; Card spends hold above ₹2 lakh-crore mark; Transaction volumes surge but the value per transaction declines

items.description: The IPO, which was open for subscription from August 19 to August 21, drew a strong response, with the issue subscribed 31.33 times overall.

items.title: Hindustan Copper OFS opens for retail investors today. Should you apply in the metals major's offer?
items.description: The OFS opened for non-retail investors on August 4, and saw strong participation. It now opens for retail investors today. Investors can participate between 9.15 am and 3.30 pm using the separate OFS window on NSE and BSE. A minimum of 10% of the offer size has been reserved for retail investors.

items.title: Groww shares in focus as Ribbit likely sells stake through Rs 1,914 crore block deal
items.description: Billionbrains Garage Ventures, the parent company of Groww, will be in focus as early investor Ribbit Capital plans to sell a 1.6% stake through a block deal worth Rs 1,914 crore. The shares are being offered at Rs 195 apiece, a 4% discount to the previous close.

items.title: Crorepati investors touch record Rs 10 lakh crore milestone. Which stocks are making them richer?
items.description: HNIs’ holdings in NSE-listed stocks surged 22.55% QoQ to a record Rs 9.92 lakh crore by June-end, adding Rs 1.83 lakh crore in three months. Their share of market value rose to 2.12%, the highest since March 2022. However, average ownership by volume fell to 7.19% from 7.31%, suggesting the rise was driven largely by stock price gains and greater exposure to high-value companies rather than fresh buying.

items.title: Hindustan Copper shares in focus as OFS opens for retail investors. Here are all the details
items.description: Hindustan Copper’s government OFS drew strong institutional demand, with the non-retail portion subscribed 3.41 times on Tuesday. The Centre exercised the full greenshoe option, taking the potential stake sale to 6%, while retail investors can bid on Wednesday at a floor price of Rs 514 per share. The company’s strong Q1 performance and plans to expand mining capacity also remain in focus.

items.title: Sensex rises over 300 points; Nifty above 24,350 as oil prices slide. What lies ahead?
items.description: On Wednesday, Indian stock markets rallied, buoyed by a decrease in oil prices and renewed optimism surrounding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, following a resumption of talks with Iran. Both the Sensex and Nifty indices showed positive momentum, with broader market metrics also trending upward, reflecting a hopeful sentiment among investors amid the fluctuating oil landscape.

items.title: HEG shares in focus as company fixes record date for demerger. What it means for shareholders
items.description: HEG shares will be in focus after the company fixed September 7 as the record date for its demerger, which will create two separately listed entities focused on graphite electrodes and advanced materials. The demerger ratio has been fixed at 1:1, with existing shareholders set to receive one share in the spun-off company for every HEG share held.

items.title: Reliance Industries, SBI among 10 stocks with highest DII holding in Q1. Do you own any?
items.description: Domestic institutional investors remain key participants in India’s equity market, with significant exposure to some of the country’s largest listed companies. Primeinfobase data for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, highlights the 10 companies with the highest DII holdings in value terms, led by major banking and corporate names.

items.description: Mopshop Distribution’s Rs 27.26-crore IPO was subscribed 1.59 times overall and 2.91 times in the retail category

items.title: Buy, Sell or Hold: Morgan Stanley maintains overweight on Varun Beverages; Nuvama retains hold on Cyient
items.description: Morgan Stanley retained its Overweight rating on Varun Beverages with a Rs 557 target, while Nuvama maintained a Hold on Cyient and raised its target to Rs 1,050. Elara Securities retained its Buy rating on Nykaa and increased its target to Rs 475, citing premiumisation, stronger customer quality and growth in online beauty and personal care.

items.title: MTAR Tech shares rally 3%, extend gains for second session. What’s triggering the surge?
items.description: MTAR Technologies shares gained 3% after the company secured a Rs 127 crore order from Nuclear Power Corporation of India for coolant channel assemblies used in reactor refurbishment. The order takes its civil nuclear order book above Rs 775 crore, while the company expects 80% revenue growth in FY27 and sees further opportunities from reactor refurbishment and new nuclear projects.
